_comment: Cube directory. id is the CubeCobra ID (short or UUID); link target is https://cubecobra.com/cube/list/<id>. nameOverride replaces the CubeCobra name when set (group nicknames). strategy is hand-curated, not auto-generated. pinned cubes sort first; the rest sort alphabetically by display name. thumbnail is an optional community-art image path, checked before cachedThumbnail. cachedName/cachedThumbnail/cachedAt are filled in by `node scripts/refresh-cube-cache.js` (run manually, then commit) — the site itself never calls the CubeCobra API, it only reads this file. Re-run the script whenever a cube's CubeCobra name or cover art changes and you want the site to pick it up.

cubes.strategy: Leans into combo and synergy over classic Vintage archetypes (e.g. Doomsday), and is currently featuring the Initiative mechanic from Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate.
Cross-synergies center on ETBs, +1/+1 counters, and cheating creatures into play.
